name: NPCs are never immune to poisons; bleed and other mechanic immunity still applies to non-poisons
contract: CoA rule: creatures not controlled by a player take every poison (Dispel 4). Hydra's Venom 285897 is a poison whose spell and effect mechanic is BLEED, so Mechanical Chicken 8376 (creature_immunities -68, BLEED only) was immune to it before; it now takes the venom. Rend 772, a bleed that is not a poison, still misses the chicken. Resist Poison 6513 (aura 41, dispel immunity to poison) on a dummy 36 blocked Poison 744 before; the dummy now takes it. A level 60 Harvest Golem 36 of the player faction 1 casts every harmful spell on level 1 fixtures, so miss, dodge and parry chances are zero and only immunity can stop a hit.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and local level scaling settle
The bleed-immune chicken takes Hydra's Venom
Hydra's Venom lands despite the chicken's bleed immunity
Give Rend its full chance to land
Bleed immunity still blocks Rend, which is not a poison
The dummy casts Resist Poison on itself
Poison lands despite the dummy's dispel immunity to poison
